units.source_text: 这所大学创始于距今近三百年前，即宽文五年，

en.t: This university was founded nearly three hundred years ago, in the fifth year of Kanbun,

units.source_text: 将筑紫观音寺的大学家迁到京都的积壳邻内，

en.t: when the Daigaku-ke of Tsukushi Kannonji was moved to the Shakkoku neighborhood in Kyoto,

units.source_text: 这就是这所大学的前身。

en.t: and this became the predecessor of the university.

units.source_text: 从此以后，这里很长时间就成为大谷派本愿寺弟子的修道院。

en.t: From then on, for a long time this place served as a monastery for disciples of the Otani branch of Honganji.

units.source_text: 到了本愿寺第十五世常如宗主时，

en.t: By the time of Jonnyo, the fifteenth head priest of Honganji,

units.source_text: 浪华的门徒高木宗贤给寺庙捐献了钱财，

en.t: a follower from Naniwa named Takagi Soken donated funds to the temple,

units.source_text: 选定格北乌丸头地方兴建了校舍。

en.t: and a site at Kita-Karasuma-gashira was chosen for the construction of school buildings.

units.source_text: 占地一万二千七百坪①，作为大学并不算大，

en.t: The grounds covered 12,700 tsubo, which was not large for a university,

units.source_text: 但它却不仅成为大谷派，

en.t: but it became a place not only for the Otani branch,

units.source_text: 而且成为各宗各派的青年来学习研修佛教哲学基础知识的据点。

en.t: but also a center where young people from many Buddhist schools and sects came to study and train in the foundations of Buddhist philosophy.
